title: Kusanagi Nene — A Dream On A Melody〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Wonderland SEKAI
se_walk_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Welcome, Nene♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Are the others here with you?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh, not yet.
We agreed to meet up here once homeroom ended for each of our classes.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: By the way, you guys...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Can we talk for a minute once Tsukasa and the others get here? I need to tell you all something before we start practice.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Sure, but is something bothering you?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: No, nothing like that...

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: About the planning committee I just mentioned.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Would you like to be a part of it?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I couldn't tell everyone that day because we didn't have practice, but I need to tell them that I've agreed to be on the planning committee for Shibu Schools Fest.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I should be focusing on my singing right now, to be ready to start training with the Morinomiya Revue...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But my teacher personally invited me.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I decided to accept because I usually shy away from doing stuff like this. It seemed like a good opportunity to make a change.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (They'll understand as long as I explain my reasoning, right...?)
se_walk_men_002_1

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Sorry for making you all wait!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Welcome, you three!
We all just finished gathering as well.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
That reminds me!
You said you wanted to tell us all something, right, Nene?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You wanna tell us something, Nene?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So, the thing is...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Well, Nene, I think you surprised us all by saying that you're going to be on the planning committee for the Shibuya City High Schools Joint Festival...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, on your teacher's recommendation no less! Congratulations!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You and your classmates worked really hard when you directed that film☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So, you guys are okay with me doing this?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hm? I don't see why we'd be against it...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: B-But I feel like I should be practicing and preparing to train with the Morinomiya Revue...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Well, what about you? Do you feel okay with doing this?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: From how it sounds, you'll have to juggle practicing with your duties as a member of this committee.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, I plan on practicing like normal, and I'm going to give this festival as much as I can too. I made a commitment, after all.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Then, I say do it.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: This is a joint festival involving all the city's high schools! Not only that, you get to be on the planning committee for the inaugural event! Go give it your best shot!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah♪ I'll be rooting for you, Nene☆

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm so happy for you, Nene.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thanks...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I promise to do my best!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Planning a festival with students from all the other schools sounds like so much fun♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, I almost wish I could be on this committee, too.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah, me too!
How are people chosen for it?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Who knows? My teacher said anyone who was interested should talk to him...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? Our teacher also mentioned the festival, but I don't think any of us were invited.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: No, we weren't.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: To be fair, each school wants to send its best representatives, which effectively takes us out of the running.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, that's unfortunate... No, wait a second! What do you mean “us”?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Unlike you, I haven't been causing trouble each and every day! I'm an excellent candidate to represent our school!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, have you forgotten what everyone at school calls us?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Umm... Remind me again☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The Weirdo Wombo Combo...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Haha... If everybody at school calls you two that, then I understand why your teachers would be hesitant to ask either of you.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Whyyyyy?!?!?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Wait, does that mean Tsukasa can't be a part of the festivities...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Probably not the planning committee, but he should still be allowed to be a part of the performances and stuff.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Thank goodness! Then, I'm gonna ask my teacher about helping with this festival♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, I'll do the same!
Maybe there's still a spot available on the planning committee.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I wouldn't get your hopes up.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Quiet, you!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thanks for giving me a chance to explain, you guys. Anyway, let's start practicing...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay♪ Let's do our best again today☆
